fact_text: InfraZamin aims to bring private-sector capital into hard-to-finance sectors such as infrastructure, agriculture, climate resilience and health by using its credit guarantees to lower sector risk.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: InfraZamin said it had issued guarantees of about 8 billion as of the interview, with the currency not stated in the transcript.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: InfraZamin offers its credit guarantee in roughly four to five products, covering long-tenor infrastructure loans, trade finance where a letter of credit cannot be opened, and other sectors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: The CEO said banks often lend for 7 to 10 years, while infrastructure needs 15 to 20 year loans, and InfraZamin's guarantee is meant to close that tenor gap.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-10)

fact_text: InfraZamin structured an agri sukuk with a partner whose name is garbled in the transcript, and closing it took about two years of due diligence on the sector and its industry.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: The CEO said the agri sukuk was a test case showing agriculture can move from lending into the capital market, and that its documented structure could serve as a blueprint for other deals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: Pakistan's government and institutions are focused on converting the financial model to Islamic banking, with the target set for 2027 and 2028, according to the InfraZamin CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: The CEO said the Islamic capital market has a large shortage of assets for investors to buy, so tapping it with guaranteed sukuk could create a deeper asset base.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: Islamic finance rests on sharing risk and profit and loss, which the CEO said fits InfraZamin's development-focused and risk-aware model naturally.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: InfraZamin plans to share its deal blueprints so other lenders can reuse them, and the CEO said more transactions are in its pipeline.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)

fact_text: The CEO said InfraZamin is optimistic about repeating the agri sukuk model and expects regulatory and policy incentive frameworks to help make such deals mainstream finance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'InfraZamin’s Role in Pakistan's Infrastructure, Gender Bonds & Agri Sukuk | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-11)
